title: rhinanthus lanceolatus
intro: Rhinanthus lanceolatus, commonly known as lance-leafed yellow rattle, is a flowering plant in the family Orobanchaceae, often parasitically associated with grasses. The plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include its use in treating various respiratory issues and as a natural expectorant to relieve congestion. The therapeutic actions of lance-leafed yellow rattle are attributed to its ability to stimulate digestion, relieve coughs, and reduce inflammation. Its bioactive constituents include alkaloids, phenolic acids, and flavonoids, which are believed to contribute to its medicinal properties.
